g.text: Phases of the Reified RSpaces campaign: the days from the first commit to the closing commit of each phase
S2 (the examples), S5 (the documents), S6 (the diagrams), S4 (the FIPS matrix),
S8 (the benchmarks), S3 (the node CLI gate, decision 136) and S9 to S11 (close-out).
P11 ran the final gate set on a development host, with no pgmcp run (decision 137).
Section 35 of the dossier records P10, and section 35.9 records P11.
P12 waits for the readiness signal of F1r3lang (SIG-F): the merge of
F1r3lang, the Rholang 1.4 productions, and TensorLogic.
